title: Weak-Side Help Rotation 3v3
description: Three defenders practise rotating as one unit when the ball drives into the lane, each reading the next pass to recover in sequence.

content.objective: Rotate as a coordinated unit on a drive, with each defender ready to cover the next pass.
content.setup: Three offensive players space around the perimeter against three live defenders.
instructions: The ball handler drives into the lane, drawing help from the nearest defender.
The helper's original player becomes open; the next defender rotates to cover them.
If the ball is passed again, the rotation continues one more step.
Reset after every possession and vary which player initiates the drive.
coachingPoints: Rotate on the drive, not after the pass has already left.
Close out with balance on the final recovery, not out of control.
commonMistakes: Rotating late and leaving a shooter open for a clean look.
Two defenders rotating to the same player and leaving another free.
Rotating to the wrong player and leaving someone else open.
content.safety: Keep drives at a controlled, game-realistic pace rather than full-contact speed.
